beats.headline: TSM drops 6.2% on broad chip selloff
beats.explanation: TSM fell 6.22% to $326.11 on 1.5 times its average volume. The decline was shared across the semiconductor sector amid macroeconomic pressures and Middle East tensions, with customer AMD down 7.49%, customer and competitor INTC falling 6.53%, and supplier ASML dropping 4.62%.

beats.headline: TSM gains 6.8% on Japan factory nod and rally
beats.explanation: TSM advanced 6.78% to close at $337.95 on 1.9 times normal volume after winning approval for a $5.26 billion 3nm chip plant in Japan. The rise coincided with a broader semiconductor relief rally as supplier ASML gained 5.33% and customer NVDA rose 5.59%.

beats.headline: TSM dips 3.1% despite record Q1 results
beats.explanation: TSM fell 3.13% to $363.35 on heavy volume of 2.72 times the average following the release of its Q1 financial results. Even though the company reported record revenue, 66.2% margins, and strong Q2 guidance, the pullback was company-specific as customers like AMD gained 7.80% and customer and competitor INTC rose 5.48%.

beats.headline: TSM climbs 5.3% as analysts raise targets
beats.explanation: TSM rose 5.26% to $387.44 on 1.68 times normal volume as Barclays raised its price target from $450 to $470 and reports highlighted strong AI order flows. Several major customers gained in tandem, with AMD rising 6.67% and AVGO up 5.09%.

beats.headline: TSM reaches $402.46 on regulatory flow and EUV news
beats.explanation: TSM gained 5.17% to $402.46 on 2.22 times average volume as regulators raised institutional holding caps and reports emerged that TSM will delay adoption of costly High-NA EUV tools to preserve margins. The strength occurred alongside massive customer rallies, including customer and competitor INTC jumping 23.60% and customer AMD advancing 13.91%.

beats.headline: TSM rises 4.5% on $1.5T 2030 industry projection
beats.explanation: TSM gained 4.48% to close at $417.72 on 1.91 times normal volume after forecasting that AI demand would drive the semiconductor industry to $1.5 trillion by 2030. The move was largely company-specific against mixed customer peers, though customers AVGO and NVDA advanced 5.52% and 4.39% respectively.

beats.headline: TSM adds 4.1% on 3nm price hike reports
beats.explanation: TSM rose 4.11% to $435.63 on 1.86 times average volume amid reports of a planned 15% price increase for 3nm chips in 2026 and an expanded manufacturing collaboration with customer NVDA. Customer NVDA gained 6.26%, while other connected peers such as customer QCOM fell 8.78% and customer and competitor INTC fell 4.67%.

beats.headline: TSM surges 6.9% on U.S. packaging deal and earnings optimism
beats.explanation: TSM shares rose 6.93% to $462.12 on 2.66 times average volume following news of a massive U.S. chip packaging partnership with Amkor Technology. The move was shared across the sector, with customer and competitor INTC jumping 10.64% and customer QCOM gaining 6.17%.

beats.headline: TSM rebounds 5.3% amid broader semi optimism
beats.explanation: TSM rose 5.26% to $455.10 on 1.53 times average volume alongside positive sentiment regarding multi-year AI semiconductor infrastructure demand. The move was shared by several peers, including supplier ASML rising 4.93% and customer AMD climbing 3.43%.

beats.headline: TSM drops 7.0% in broad tech sector pullback
beats.explanation: TSM fell 6.98% to $444.23 on 1.91 times average volume during a broad tech rotation out of semiconductor leaders. The drop was shared by key partners, with customer and competitor INTC down 9.03%, supplier ASML down 7.36%, and customer AMD falling 6.89%.

beats.headline: TSM rises 5.5% on planned 2027 foundry price hikes
beats.explanation: TSM advanced 5.55% to $424.61 on 1.87 times average volume following reports that it plans to raise chipmaking prices by up to 10% in 2027. Connected peers moved higher in tandem, led by customer and competitor INTC up 8.64% and customer AMD up 8.11%.

beats.headline: TSM jumps 7.6% on AI packaging tech report
beats.explanation: TSM rose 7.64% to $403.31 on 1.8 times normal volume following reports that it developed new advanced AI chip packaging technology to counter competition. The gain was shared widely across the industry, with customer AMD gaining 13.00% and customer and competitor INTC rising 11.30%.

arc: Between late March and late July 2026, TSM experienced strong upward momentum underpinned by unprecedented demand for AI accelerator fabrication, aggressive international capacity expansion, and exceptional pricing leverage. While macroeconomic headwinds and geopolitical tensions periodically triggered industry-wide selloffs, TSM consistently demonstrated pricing power through planned 10% to 15% rate increases on leading-edge 3nm and future nodes. Despite occasional post-earnings digestion and periodic tech rotations shared with key customers like AMD and INTC, TSM capitalized on sold-out advanced foundry capacity and new packaging developments to anchor the broader semiconductor market expansion.
